newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: No word on storm damage to Colombian coffee.
newsitem.headline: No word on storm damage to Colombian coffee.

text.p: There was no immediate word Monday on possible damage to the coffee crop in Colombia's central Risaralda province, where torrential rains and gale-force winds battered a slum on the outskirts of the provincial capital over the weekend.

Jaime Marulanda, assistant to the executive director of the Risaralda Coffee Growers Committee, said the storm of "unusual intensity" appeared to have been centered over the urban area of Pereira and the working-class district of Dosquebradas where at least four people were killed in flash floods Saturday night.
But in terms of coffee, and the harvest that begins next month, Marulanda said no assessment of possible damages was likely before Tuesday.
